quests.title: Hello, Hotaru
quests.summary: Hotaru is dozing on the shelf. Send her a greeting through the loft terminal.
lesson: The terminal shows the output of your program. A greeting addressed to Hotaru rings her message bell when you send it.
`print()` sends words out of your program. Words go inside quotation marks.
Test ghost-types your actual words above the player and shows them on the screen. Send message delivers them to Hotaru. After she wakes, answer her question.
hints: A greeting addressed to Hotaru rings her message bell.
A greeting with her name: print("Hello, Hotaru!")

quests.title: The waiting ticket
quests.summary: Nell has left a work ticket on the board by the window.
lesson: Find the job board beside the workshop window. Press F to read the ticket.
hints: The board is on the wall beside the armchair. Read the ticket with F.
quests.done: The fitting is repaired. The new relay is waiting for its instruction.

quests.title: The landing light
quests.summary: The stair lantern has a new relay. Nell wants it back in service before evening.
lesson: Stand beside the stair lantern with your tablet and press F to open its code. Code reaches only what you are standing beside.
The ticket gives the lantern’s address: landing-lamp. The relay is sound; this routine decides whether it is on.
world.lamp("landing-lamp") finds that lamp. set_lit(True) switches it on; False switches it off.
Test shows the proposed light in the workshop. Apply routine keeps the tested change.
hints: The starter tells the lamp to stay off. Look at the value inside set_lit(...).
Use True to request light, then Test and Apply routine.

quests.title: The morning round
quests.concept: A list and a for loop
quests.summary: The opening card lists the stair lantern and both work lights. Finish Nell’s round while she is out.
lesson: Jack your tablet into the wall screen. A whole zone is reached from its screen, not from each lamp, and only while you stand at it.
The old card reaches one lamp. The workshop needs all three: landing-lamp, repair-light and assembly-light.
The screen names this zone workshop. world.zone("workshop").lamps is its list of lamps. A for loop runs the indented instruction once for each item.
Replace the single-item instruction with a loop over the list. Your earlier stair-light work stays saved on its own page.
hints: The starter only uses lamps[0], the first lamp in the list.
Start with for lamp in lamps: and indent lamp.set_lit(True) beneath it.
quests.done: Both tables and the stairs are lit. The opening card is ready.
